children: By Bharath Rajeswaran and Vivek Kumar M
Indian shares were little changed on Friday, after recording their steepest drop in 10 weeks in the previous session, as high crude prices and global bond yields continued to weigh on sentiment.
The Nifty 50
rose 0.09% to 23,084.4, while the BSE Sensex
added 0.13% to 73,674.57, as of 9:39 a.m. IST.
Ten of the 16 major sectors advanced on the day, after the broad selloff in the previous session.
IT
fell 0.7%, as crude prices above $100 a barrel intensified inflationary worries and bolstered bets on multiple Federal Reserve rate hikes in the near term.
Higher U.S. rates could dent demand and economic growth in sectors exposed to the geography, such as Indian IT.
The broader small-caps
rose 0.2% while mid-caps
traded flat.

"Markets are likely to remain subdued in the near term with renewed uncertainty over a potential resolution of US-Iran conflict, elevated crude prices and rising global bond yields," said Siddhartha Khemka, head of research of wealth management of Motilal Oswal Financial Services.

The Nifty 50 and Sensex suffered their steepest one-day percentage declines in 10 weeks on Thursday, as rising oil prices reignited inflation fears and proposed insurance commission caps hit financial stocks.

"Momentum has weakened considerably following the breakdown. While benchmarks are approaching oversold territory, a technical bounce would require price-based confirmation," said Dhupesh Dhameja, derivatives research analyst at SAMCO Securities.
Among stocks, Meesho
fell about 4% after Nomura initiated coverage with "reduce" and projected about 28% downside from its last close.
Steel pipemaker Welspun Corp
gained 4% after winning largest-ever order worth $412.5 million for high-frequency-induction-welded pipes.
Syrma SGS Technology
gained 2.1% after Axis Capital reiterated "buy" and raised price target to 1,956 rupees from 1,605 rupees, projecting a 15% upside.
Vascon Engineers
jumped 10% after the construction and engineering company secured an order worth $69 million.
